arxiv-1609-04749.title: On some curvature restricted geometric structures for projective curvature tensor
arxiv-1609-04749.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh and Haradhan Kundu
arxiv-1609-04749.description: Abstract . The projective curvature tensor P P is invariant under a geodesic preserving transformation on a semi-Riemannian manifold. It is well known that P P is not a generalized curvature tensor and hence it possesses different geometric properties than other generalized curvature tensors.

arxiv-2205-07190.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Diffuse Interface Model for Cell Adhesion and Aggregation
arxiv-2205-07190.creator: Lingyue Shen, Ping Lin, Zhiliang Xu, Shixin Xu
arxiv-2205-07190.description: Abstract A thermodynamically consistent phase-field model is introduced for simulating multicellular deformation, aggreggation under flow conditions. In particular, a Lennard-Jones type potential is proposed under phase field framework for cell-cell, cell-wall interactions. A second-order accurate in both space and time C 0 C^{0} finite element method is proposed to solved the model governing equations.

arxiv-2210-15573.title: Multi-task Bias-Variance Trade-off Through Functional Constraints
arxiv-2210-15573.creator: Juan Cerviño, Juan Andrés Bazerque, Miguel Calvo-Fullana, Alejandro Ribeiro
arxiv-2210-15573.description: Abstract Multi-task learning aims to acquire a set of functions, either regressors or classifiers, that perform well for diverse tasks. At its core, the idea behind multi-task learning is to exploit the intrinsic similarity across data sources to aid in the learning process for each individual domain.

arxiv-2305-07111.title: MCRB on DOA Estimation for Automotive MIMO Radar in the Presence of Multipath
arxiv-2305-07111.creator: M. Levy-Israel, Student Member, IEEE, I. Bilik, Senior Member, IEEE, J. Tabrikian, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2305-07111.description: Abstract Autonomous driving and advanced active safety features require accurate high-resolution sensing capabilities. Automotive radars are the key component of the vehicle sensing suit. However, when these radars operate in proximity to flat surfaces, such as roads and guardrails, they experience a multipath phenomenon that can degrade the accuracy of the direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation.

arxiv-2402-16571.title: On the causal discontinuity of Morse spacetimes
arxiv-2402-16571.creator: Lucas Dahinden, Liang Jin
arxiv-2402-16571.description: Abstract . Morse spacetime is a model of singular Lorentzian manifold, built upon a Morse function which serves as a global time function outside its critical points. The Borde–Sorkin conjecture states that a Morse spacetime is causally continuous if and only if the index and coindex of critical points of the corresponding Morse function are both different from 1.

arxiv-2505-00325.title: CognitionNet: A Collaborative Neural Network for Play Style Discovery in Online Skill Gaming Platform
arxiv-2505-00325.creator: Rukma Talwadker, Surajit Chakrabarty, Aditya Pareek, Tridib Mukherjee, Deepak Saini
arxiv-2505-00325.description: Abstract . Games are one of the safest source of realizing self-esteem and relaxation at the same time ( TechnoSports 2021 ; raiseyourskillz [n. d.] ) . An online gaming platform typically has massive data coming in, e.g., in-game actions, player moves, clickstreams, transactions etc.

arxiv-2509-05087.title: Overcharging Extremal Rotating Black Holes
arxiv-2509-05087.creator: Shauvik Biswas, Amruta Sadhu, Sudipta Sarkar
arxiv-2509-05087.description: Abstract In this work, we use the weak cosmic censorship conjecture (WCC) to constrain black hole solutions in modified gravity theories. While Wald showed that extremal Kerr–Newman black holes in general relativity cannot be overcharged by test charged particles, this protection may fail in theories beyond general relativity.

arxiv-2512-15532.title: A conditioned UNet for Music Source Separation
arxiv-2512-15532.creator: Ken O’Hanlon, Basil Woods, Lin Wang, Mark Sandler
arxiv-2512-15532.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ken O’Hanlon, Basil Woods, Lin Wang, Mark Sandler. In this paper we propose a conditioned UNet for Music Source Separation (MSS). MSS is generally performed by multi-output neural networks, typically UNets, with each output representing a particular stem from a predefined instrument vocabulary. In contrast, conditioned MSS networks accept an audio query related to a stem of interest alongside the signal from which that stem is to be extracted. Thus, a strict vocabulary is not required and this enables more realistic tasks in MSS.

pmc-11282232.title: Dynamics of co-composting of pineapple harvest and processing residues with poultry litter and compost quality
pmc-11282232.creator: Elvire Line Sossa, Codjo Emile Agbangba, Tatiana Windékpè Koura, Oladéji Jamali Ayifimi, Issiakou Alladé Houssoukpèvi, Nadège Donsaré Bana Bouko, Florent Yalinkpon, Guillaume Lucien Amadji
pmc-11282232.description: The production of pineapple generates significant quantities of harvest and processing residues, which are very little used. This study evaluates compost quality using pineapple residues and poultry litter. Five composting treatments were tested, varying following proportions of crown, pineapple processing wastes (PPW), pineapple harvest residue (PHR), and poultry litter (PL).

pmc-11321085.title: Pulmonary abscess secondary to epididymitis caused by extended spectrum β-lactamase-producing hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae: a case report
pmc-11321085.creator: Runjun Li, Junlong Liu, Liye Yang, Zhiwei Lin, Ling Rong, Gang Chen, Xiuying Tang
pmc-11321085.description: BackgroundPulmonary abscesses resulting from epididymitis caused by extended spectrum β-lactamase-producing hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae (ESBL-hvKp) in a nondiabetic patient are extremely uncommon. The infection caused by this disseminated drug-resistant bacteria, which is generally considered an intractable case, poses a potential challenge in clinical practice.

pmc-11606430.title: Natural variation in the chickpea metabolome under drought stress
pmc-11606430.creator: Palak Chaturvedi, Iro Pierides, Cristina López‐Hidalgo, Vanika Garg, Shuang Zhang, Rutwik Barmukh, Anke Bellaire, Jiahang Li, Gert Bachmann, Luis Valledor, Rajeev K. Varshney, Arindam Ghatak, Wolfram Weckwerth
pmc-11606430.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryChickpea is the world's fourth largest grown legume crop, which significantly contributes to food security by providing calories and dietary protein globally. However, the increased frequency of drought stress has significantly reduced chickpea production in recent years. Here, we have performed a field experiment with 36 diverse chickpea genotypes to evaluate grain yield, photosynthetic activities and molecular traits related to drought stress. For metabolomics analysis, leaf tissue was collected at three time points representing different pod‐filling stages.

pmc-11615203.title: Reliability evaluation of electric-gas-thermal coupling systems considering the post-fault operation modes of user-level integrated energy system
pmc-11615203.creator: Bo Zhang, Jia Li, Lu Zhang, Wei Tang, Yan Sun
pmc-11615203.description: SummaryThe distribution network with user-level integrated energy systems (UIESs) represents a new form of future energy systems. Traditional reliability evaluation methods for distribution networks with multiple UIESs are no longer applicable due to their multi-energy coupling and island operation. To address this, a reliability evaluation method for electric-gas-thermal coupling systems with UIESs is introduced.

pmc-11677870.title: Cannabichromene as a Novel Inhibitor of Th2 Cytokine and JAK/STAT Pathway Activation in Atopic Dermatitis Models
pmc-11677870.creator: Ki Chan Kim, Ga Hee Jeong, Chul Hwan Bang, Ji Hyun Lee
pmc-11677870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cannabichromene (CBC) is one of the main cannabinoids found in the cannabis plant, and although less well known than tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD), it is gaining attention for its potential therapeutic benefits.

pmc-12467733.title: Evaluation of Measurement Errors in Rotational Stitching, One-Shot, and Slot-Scanning Full-Length Radiography
pmc-12467733.creator: Zhengliang Li, Jie Xia, Cong Wang, Zhemin Zhu, Fan Zhang, Tsung-Yuan Tsai, Zhenhong Zhu, Kai Yang, Fabiano Bini
pmc-12467733.description: Full-length radiography is essential for evaluating spinal deformities, limb length discrepancies, and preoperative planning in orthopedics, yet the measurement accuracy of different radiographic methods remains unclear. This phantom study compared the accuracy of rotational stitching, one-shot and slot-scanning full-length radiography across six radiographic systems in quantifying distances between anatomical landmarks. Measurement errors were statistically analyzed using appropriate nonparametric tests.

pmc-12477552.title: The Immunoglobulin Domain of SISS-1/EGF is Required for its Function
pmc-12477552.creator: Jesse G Jones, Cheryl Van Buskirk
pmc-12477552.description: Epidermal growth factor (EGF) signaling plays roles in development and physiology across the animal kingdom. In the nematode C. elegans , a single EGF receptor (EGFR) and two EGF family ligands have been characterized. LIN-3 /EGF is required for a variety of developmental processes as well as ovulation, and SISS-1 /EGF promotes a damage-responsive quiescent state known as stress-induced sleep.

pmc-12526504.title: Effect of Heat Treatment on In Vitro Cytotoxicity of Ti-Nb-Zr Gum Metal Alloy
pmc-12526504.creator: Arash Etemad, Saeed Hasani, Alireza Mashreghi, Fariba Heidari, Parinaz Salehikahrizsangi, Sabine Schwarz, Katarzyna Bloch, Marcin Nabialek
pmc-12526504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Strain-induced deformations and phase evolutions are two hidden factors that may influence cytocompatibility of Gum Metal alloys during processing for relevant implant applications. In the present research, changes in cell viability of a new Gum Metal Ti-Nb-Zr alloy in its cold-rolled state and after heat treatments (at 700, 850, and 900 °C) were investigated by a comprehensive study of microstructural phases and their role in deformation mechanisms as well as mechanical properties.

pmc-12754176.title: Prediction of histopathological grade in gastric cancer using dual energy CT-derived synthetic extracellular volume fraction
pmc-12754176.creator: Hai-fei Zhou, Wei Chen, Jing-qi Li, Ai-yun Sun, Li-li Guo
pmc-12754176.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeTo investigate the relationship between the synthetic extracellular volume (ECV) fraction and the hematocrit (HCT)-based ECV fraction in gastric cancer patients and to evaluate its potential utility in predicting the pathological grade of gastric cancer.MethodsData from the derivation cohort consisting of 142 patients who underwent nonenhanced abdominal CT examination were collected, and the CT values of the abdominal aorta (CTA) and inferior vena cava (CTV) were measured separately.

pmc-13072002.title: Characterization of Nigella sativa Meal (NSM) and the Effects on In Vitro Rumen Fermentation and Degradability
pmc-13072002.creator: Karina Natasya Juandita, Diky Ramdani, Iman Hernaman, Abdul Shakoor Chaudhry, Sukarman, Ki Ageng Sarwono
pmc-13072002.description: Simple SummaryThe Nigella sativa L. oil extraction process generates a by-product known as Nigella sativa meal (NSM). This meal may be used as an affordable local feed to meet the growing challenge of limited feed availability to satisfy the nutritional requirements of sheep.

pmc-13121513.title: Preliminary investigation of circulating methaemoglobin fraction in cats with sepsis: a small exploratory study
pmc-13121513.creator: Shanon McGuigan, Erica Tinson, Lee Beever, Rachael Birkbeck
pmc-13121513.description: ObjectivesThis exploratory study aimed to evaluate the methaemoglobin fraction in cats with sepsis, non-septic sick counterparts and healthy controls, and to assess the feasibility of using the methaemoglobin fraction as a biomarker for predicting clinically relevant outcomes such as duration of hospitalisation and mortality.

pmc-13287862.title: 31Survival Outcomes in Cholangiocarcinoma Patients Treated with Radiation Therapy
pmc-13287862.creator: Tzipora Schein, Michael Buckstein
pmc-13287862.description: Background & ObjectivesCholangiocarcinoma is a rare and aggressive biliary tract cancer. Although surgery oﬀers the best chance for long-term survival, most patients are not surgical candidates at diagnosis. Radiation therapy (RT) is often used for local tumor control, but data on optimal RT technique and integration with systemic therapies are limited.

pmc-13634486.title: Bilateral Chronic Central Serous Chorioretinopathy Leads to Macular Atrophy: A Case Report
pmc-13634486.creator: Othman Haddani, Noor R Jaber, Amine Razzak, Mohamed Bouazza, Mohamed Elbelhadji
pmc-13634486.description: We report a rare case of progressive bilateral atrophic maculopathy in the setting of a pachychoroid, secondary to chronic and complicated central serous chorioretinopathy (CSCR). A 58-year-old man reported progressive bilateral visual acuity loss and a central scotoma in the left eye, with a background of longstanding contralateral CSCR.
